# ovirt_storage_domain (Data Source)

The ovirt_storage_domain data source returns the ID and details of a storage domain by its name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the storage domain. Either name or id must be specified.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the storage domain. Either name or id must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Number) Available space on the storage domain in bytes.
- `external_status` (String) External status of the storage domain.
- `status` (String) Status of the storage domain (e.g. active, etc.).
- `storage_type` (String) Type of the storage domain (e.g. nfs, iscsi, fcp, etc.).
